paper.title: BindGPT: A Scalable Framework for 3D Molecular Design via Language Modeling and Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: BindGPT 是一个将 3D 分子设计表述为文本生成的语言模型框架，用结构 SMILES 加空间 XYZ 格式同时描述分子图与原子坐标，从而无需外部软件重建分子图 [S1.p5][S3.SS1.p2]。模型先在 Uni-Mol 的大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练，再在 CrossDocked 或 GEOM-DRUGS 上监督微调，并用外部对接软件奖励进行强化学习 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。实验表明，单个预训练语言模型可同时作为 3D 分子生成器、给定分子图的构象生成器和口袋条件 3D 分子生成器，在多个任务上达到或超过专门的扩散模型、语言模型和图神经网络，且采样成本低两个数量级 [abstract][S4.SS1.p3][S4.SS2.p3]。作者认为该工作把大规模预训练范式从 NLP 有效迁移到了 3D 药物发现 [S5.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的核心问题是：如何用一个概念简单、可扩展的生成框架，在蛋白质结合位点内生成具有 3D 结构的分子，并避免依赖外部工具进行键重建 [abstract][S1.p2]。原文指出，多数空间分子生成器只关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等工具重建键，而原子位置的微小偏差可能显著改变重建的分子图甚至使其断开 [S1.p2]。作者还强调，3D 分子生成在语言模型方法中受到的关注有限，他们希望提出首个把现代 decoder-only 语言建模范式应用于 3D 药物发现并覆盖多个下游任务的方法 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: we present a novel generative model, BindGPT which uses a conceptually simple but powerful approach to create 3D molecules within the protein’s binding site
most spatial molecular generators focus exclusively on atom types and locations. They depend on supplementary tools, such as OpenBabel, for the critical task of bond reconstruction.
minor positional adjustments can significantly alter reconstructed molecular bonds or even make the molecular graph disconnected
the challenge of 3D molecule generation has received limited attention in language model approach
we propose the first approach that applies the modern decoder-only language modeling paradigm to the 3D drug discovery problem with several downstream applications

method.text: 方法核心是把多种 3D 分子设计任务统一表述为带提示的文本生成，把条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前，例如用蛋白质口袋作为口袋条件生成的提示、用 2D 分子结构作为构象生成的提示 [S3.p1]。模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构并使用旋转位置嵌入以支持长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。表示上，作者把 XYZ 格式与 SMILES 格式耦合，强制两者原子顺序一致，并从 XYZ 中移除原子符号，从而同时描述分子图和原子位置，避免外部图重建 [S3.SS1.p2]。训练流程包括在大规模 3D 分子与口袋数据上预训练、在 CrossDocked 或 GEOM-DRUGS 上监督微调，以及用 REINFORCE 和外部对接软件奖励进行强化学习 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: The main principle in our approach is to formulate several 3D molecular design task as prompted generation of text.
a prompt can be the protein pocket for the pocket-conditioned generation task or the 2D molecular structure for the conformation generation task
we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX
architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings. This technique allows for the length generalization
we propose to couple the XYZ format with the SMILES format
we enforce to have the same atom ordering in both. We also remove the atom symbol from the XYZ representation
we use a large-scale but specialized dataset of 3D molecules and protein pockets
we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020, which is a high-quality dataset containing aligned pocket-ligand pairs
We apply the REINFORCE algorithm for further model finetuning.
we compute the reward using an external docking software that estimates the binding energy between the pocket and the generated ligand

experiments.text: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 208M 个构象、12M 个分子和 3.2M 个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 上微调，作者过滤后得到约 27M 个口袋-配体对，覆盖 14k 分子与 3k 口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。3D 分子生成和 3D 构象生成任务还在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调，该数据集包含 300k 分子的 27M 个构象，并用 Platinum 数据集作为零样本构象生成的留出评估集 [S4.p2]。评估指标包括有效性、类药性指标 SA/QED/Lipinski、分布度量、RMSD、生成 1K 个有效 3D 分子的时间，以及构象生成的 RMSD-coverage [S4.SS1.p1]；口袋条件任务使用 QVINA 计算的结合能和类药性指标 [S4.SS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
we use the aforementioned CrossDocked dataset which contains aligned pocket-molecule pairs
Our filtration of the dataset has around 27M pocket-ligand pairs covering a cross product of 14k molecules with 3k pockets
We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
we also finetune the model on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset
This dataset contains 27M conformations for 300k molecules
we use the Platinum dataset as a hold-out evaluation dataset to test our model and baselines on zero-shot conformer generation
We provide the validity ( $\uparrow$) of generated molecules and druglikeness metrics - SA ( $\uparrow$), QED ( $\uparrow$), and Lipinski ( $\uparrow$)
we measure the time needed to generate 1K valid 3D molecules on one GPU
For the 3D conformation generation given molecule task, we compute the RMSD-coverage ( $\uparrow$) metric.
The first one is represented via the binding energy ( $\downarrow$) computed by the QVINA docking software

findings.text: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不使用和显式使用氢原子的设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢原子的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上取得当前最佳表现，尽管在类药性上未超过 MolDiff [S4.SS1.p3]。在构象生成任务中，BindGPT 借助 RDKit 工具时可匹配 Torsional Diffusion 的表现，不借助时存在小差距，而 Uni-Mol 未能泛化到 Platinum 数据集 [S4.SS1.p3]。在口袋条件生成任务中，经强化学习微调的 BindGPT-RL 能更高效地搜索结合分子空间，并在结合能上显著优于此前最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。作者总结称，该方法在多个 3D 分子生成任务上匹配或超越基线，且不依赖生成域的归纳偏置 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens
BindGPT is the first model capable of modeling hydrogen explicitly at such large scale
BindGPT (being finetuned on this data) shows state-of-the-art performance scores for nearly all distributional evaluation metrics
Even though BindGPT does not outperform MolDiff in Druglikeness
BindGPT, in contrast, is capable of matching the performance of TD when assisted by the RDKit tool and having a small gap when not.
Surprisingly, Uni-Mol fails to generalize to this new dataset
the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy
we demonstrate the generality of our approach as it can solve each of them by matching or surpassing the baselines
our method does not have any inductive biases about the generative domain acting as a general and data-driven approach

limitations.text: 作者在附录中说明，模型规模实验显示模型在 300M 参数之前扩展良好，但到该规模时困惑度出现过拟合，因此后续实验采用 100M 模型 [A3.p1]。作者还表示，当前 108M 模型是在给定预训练数据集下取得最佳表现，并认为通过增加预训练数据量可以进一步提升模型质量 [A3.p1]。

evidence.quote: we observed that the model scales well up until the size of 300M parameters, where its perplexity shows overfitting
We believe the model quality can be improved further by increasing the amount of the data for pretraining and the current 108M model obtains the best performance given the pretraining dataset.
